package.description: High-performance, open-source Windows cleaner and memory optimizer with zero telemetry.

en-US.description: High-performance, open-source Windows cleaner and memory optimizer with zero telemetry.
en-US.longDescription:
Deltempo is a fast, transparent Windows cache cleaner, disk space recovery, and RAM optimization utility.
It cleans 26+ safe system cache locations (Windows Temp, Prefetch, Thumbnails, Delivery Optimization, Crash Dumps,
Browser caches for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox, Opera, and Dev tools like VS, NuGet, npm, pip, Gradle, Docker),
integrates the verified WinMemoryCleaner NT kernel memory optimizer, provides a high-DPI system tray monitor with live RAM stats,
and offers full CLI automation with zero telemetry.
en-US.name: Deltempo
